interface.longDescription:
Tako searches licensed and public datasets and the live web in one call, and returns current figures as citation-backed charts alongside web results. Use it for company financials and analyst estimates, stock prices and valuation, economic indicators such as inflation, unemployment, GDP, and interest rates, website and app traffic, prediction-market odds, sports statistics, demographics, energy, and real estate. Sources include S&P Global, Fiscal.ai, Visible Alpha, Xignite, FRED, BLS, OECD, BIS, IMF, World Bank, Census, and Polymarket.

Tako also fetches the full text of a web result or the data rows behind a chart, lists the data it holds on a company, country, or metric, and turns data you provide into a shareable chart.

Tako is for analysts, researchers, writers, and anyone who needs a sourced number. Sign in with a Tako account to use it. Charts you create from your own data are public: anyone with the link can open them. Coverage varies by metric and region.
